item.name: text-reveal
item.summary: headline: Typography reveal by word/line/char with font-ready splitting (dom, server-safe, <3 KB, reduced motion -> static, mobile -> reduced stagger)

useWhen: Hero headlines and section titles requiring editorial typographic reveals
Marketing landing pages with high-signal opening statements
Feature headings that need stepped entrance animations
avoidWhen: Long paragraphs or running prose (> 2 lines of body text)
Frequently updating real-time data or tickers

alternatives.name: scroll-reveal
alternatives.when: When revealing whole blocks, cards, or media rather than individual text tokens

tiers.0: Static un-animated text rendered immediately without split tokens
tiers.1: Word-level reveal with reduced stagger duration (40ms)
tiers.2: Full word or line reveal with standard stagger (60ms)
tiers.3: Full word, line, or character reveal with high-precision stagger

reducedMotion.description: Renders plain static text without splitting or animations.

input.pointer: None; typography entrance runs once upon mounting
input.touch: Same as fine pointer with mobile-optimized stagger timing
input.keyboard: Text is fully focusable and selectable with standard native cursor

a11y.notes: Original text is preserved in a visually-hidden span while animated tokens are marked aria-hidden='true', ensuring screen readers never read fragmented letters or words.

props.name: children
props.effect: Text string to split and reveal.

props.name: as
props.effect: HTML tag to render as root container.

props.name: delay
props.effect: Initial delay in ms before animation begins.

props.name: stagger
props.effect: Delay in ms between subsequent token animations.

props.name: duration
props.effect: Duration in ms for each token entrance.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on device capability tier.

props.name: replayKey
props.effect: Optional key to force replaying the entrance animation.

mistakes: Do not pass complex React elements or JSX as children; TextReveal expects a text string to tokenize.
Do not hide text with opacity: 0 before hydration; the component handles static visibility safely.
verify: Verify full headline text is present in server HTML before JavaScript executes.
Verify screen reader reads text as a single coherent sentence without letter-by-letter pauses.
Verify reduced motion produces immediate static text with zero rAF cycles.
